ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be
amended by changing all the RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-
Unit District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 20-A in the area
bounded by

A line 198.5 feet south of and parallel to East 85" Street; the public alley

next east of and parallel to South Burley Avenue; and a line 248.5 feet south
of and parallel to East 85" Street; and South Burley Avenue

to those of a B2-1 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 8521 South Burley Avenue
